findings.evidence: /tmp/vgoal/u10/fg3/probes/extremes.cjs. Node v24.16.0 `node node-run.cjs ./extremes.cjs`: runInThisContext('\nthrow new Error("x")',{filename:'/v/a.js',lineOffset:2147483647}) -> `/v/a.js:-2147483647:7`; columnOffset 2147483647 on line 1 -> `/v/b.js:1:-2147483642`; hook getters `,7,/v/e.js:-2147483647:7` (getLineNumber null) and `1,,/v/f.js:1:-2147483642` (getColumnNumber null). Rifty HEAD, Node host (`tsx rifty-run.mts extremes.cjs`): `/v/a.js:2147483649:7`, `/v/b.js:1:2147483654`, hook `2147483649,7,…`, `1,2147483654,…`. Minimum values (-2147483648) match Node (no wrap below).
findings.summary: At the int32 ceiling V8 computes line+lineOffset / column+columnOffset in int32 and wraps (Node prints -2147483647, getters null); rifty adds in doubles and prints 2147483649. Contract A2/Context state the arithmetic as 'line + lineOffset, unclamped' and never state wrap-around, so exactness beyond the clause (REV-3) - advisory; a `| 0` in shiftLine/shiftColumn/projectedToString plus one parity row would match Node, or record it.
